confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from mixed, partly dated sources. Beer and cappuccino come from Taipei and nationwide crowd-sourced averages, adjusted upward for a resort town. Cocktail and wine anchors come from Taipei bar and hotel price ranges, with cocktail and wine not directly verified for Kenting. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Kenting's resort-area market; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX is the most recent RBA observation I could verify (20 March 2026), not the current rate as of 19 November 2026. I could not retrieve the current RBA F11.1 table, so the rate may be stale by several months.
comparable_city_reasoning: Taiwan domestic price levels, using Taipei restaurant, beer and cappuccino data as the baseline and adjusting for Kenting's resort premium. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a southern Taiwan beach resort town with seasonal demand.
